name: Cá mú
summary: Cá mú is one line at the floating door Trang Nhung, vịnh Cảng Cá, on the 20 June 2013 board. From 10 November 2021 the city moved the fish-port logistics from the Cát Bà port in the town to cảng cá Trân Châu. The notice does not say these kitchens moved.
howToEat: Order it by weight. The cooking method is not given. A current price is Check on arrival.
where: Vịnh Cảng Cá, as that 2013 address prints it. A current door is Check on arrival.
